::: {#exr-miller-dint-linear-plane}
#### Double integral of an affine function

Adapted from @problifesavercalc, Question 1.1.53.

Let $a, b, c$ be constants. Evaluate:

$$\int_0^1 \int_0^1 (ax + by + c)\,dy\,dx$$
:::

::: {#sol-miller-dint-linear-plane}
By linearity of the integral:

$$\ba
\int_0^1 \int_0^1 (ax + by + c)\,dy\,dx &= a\int_0^1 x\,dx \int_0^1 1\,dy + b\int_0^1 1\,dx \int_0^1 y\,dy + c\int_0^1 1\,dx \int_0^1 1\,dy
\\
&= a\paren{\frac{1}{2}}(1) + b(1)\paren{\frac{1}{2}} + c(1)(1)
\\
&= \frac{a}{2} + \frac{b}{2} + c
\ea$$
:::
